project_overview: A system for managing police cases with features for registration, investigation, prosecution, search, and audit trail management.

actors.description: Support staff who handle defects and enhancement requests

actors.name: Auditor
actors.description: External auditor who reviews audit trails

constraints.description: System must provide context-sensitive help for all UI actions
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

constraints.description: System must provide interface for logging defects and enhancement requests
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

constraints.description: System must maintain unalterable audit trail for all actions on critical entities
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word 'unalterable' is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: Audit trail must track events automatically once activated
constraints.source_text: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

constraints.description: Audit trail must be maintained at least for the life of the case
constraints.source_text: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

constraints.description: System must allow limiting case access to specific users/groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: System must allow users to be members of multiple groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

constraints.description: Only admin users can set up user profiles and allocate users to groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

constraints.description: Audit trail data must be available for inspection on request
constraints.source_text: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

constraints.description: System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

constraints.description: System must capture and store access control violations
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user's attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.

constraints.description: System must provide case action reports organized by case, user, and chronologically
constraints.source_text: By case; By user; In chronological sequence. The System must at a minimum be able to provide reports for actions on cases organised:

constraints.description: Only super-user can change security attributes for groups or users
constraints.source_text: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

constraints.description: Search results must never include records the user doesn't have right to access
constraints.source_text: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

constraints.description: Unauthorized access attempts must be logged in audit trail
constraints.source_text: If the System allows users to make unauthorised attempts to access cases, it must log these in the audit trail.

constraints.description: All error messages must be meaningful and actionable
constraints.source_text: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

constraints.description: System must employ consistent UI rules for common look and feel
constraints.source_text: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

constraints.description: System must be able to display multiple entities simultaneously
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

constraints.description: Interfaces must be customizable/user-configurable where possible
constraints.source_text: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

constraints.description: UI must be suitable for users with special needs
constraints.source_text: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

constraints.description: System must perform simple search in 5-8 seconds, advanced in 10-15 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

constraints.description: System must retrieve recently accessed cases within 5-8 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

constraints.description: System must retrieve infrequently accessed cases within 20 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

constraints.description: System must be scalable for use in small or large police stations
constraints.source_text: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

constraints.description: System should support multilingual interface
constraints.source_text: The system should support multilingual interface

constraints.description: System should not lose operational data in case of failure
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

constraints.description: System should support SSL encrypted connections
constraints.source_text: The system should support SSL encrypted connections

constraints.description: System should support secure VPN connections
constraints.source_text: The system should support secure virtual private network connections

exceptions.trigger: User attempts to access a case they don't have permission for
exceptions.handling: Log attempt in audit trail and show appropriate error message

exceptions.trigger: User attempts to access a non-existent case
Search takes longer than allowed time
exceptions.handling: Show timeout message and suggest refining search criteria

exceptions.trigger: Error occurs during audit trail export
